summary: This Form 6-K filed by Melco Resorts & Entertainment LTD merely announces the release date for its Q1 2026 unaudited financial results and provides conference call details. No special situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change—is described. The filing is a routine earnings release date notification, not a special situation. Therefore, it falls under None.
